outcome: COVID symptoms (fever, sore throat, loss of taste sensation, loss of smell sensation)
cohort: The study included 244 pregnant patients with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection via PCR test, with a mean age of 31.4 years in the vaccinated group and 28.3 years in the unvaccinated group, most of whom were in their third trimester.
finding: Unvaccinated pregnant patients with COVID-19 had an increased requirement for intensive care for both mother and newborn, experienced more prolonged COVID symptoms (sore throat, loss of taste/smell), and had longer hospital stays compared to vaccinated pregnant patients.
